Revenue for the quarter grew by 25.3%, while EBITDA increased by 15.2% with EBITDA

material prices, we delivered 20% underlying revenue growth while delivering EBITDA

based across both categories and geographies. Beauty & Cosmetics maintained its strong growth
trajectory with growth exceeding 20%, while Oral Care also crossed the 20% growth mark.
Personal Care & Beyond continues to expand and now accounts for 54% of our portfolio, further

Europe and AMESA grew by 20.2% and 17%, respectively, marking another quarter where

judicious pricing across all our regions and customers. Further, our frugal mindset and relentless
cost discipline enabled us to continue making growth investments while staying in the target
margin range.
